component.name: Zephyr Terminal
component.summary: Fast, modern terminal emulator with tabs, splits and profiles

description.p: Zephyr Terminal is a native Linux terminal emulator written in C++20 and Qt 6. It runs your shell on a real pseudo-terminal, renders 24-bit color and Unicode, and keeps the interface out of the way.

ul.li: Tabs and freely nested horizontal and vertical split panes
Search through scrollback, configurable history size and cursor styles
Shell profiles with arguments, working directory and environment variables
Dark, light and system themes with a custom accent color and transparency
Command palette, editable keybindings and session restore
Safe paste: control characters are stripped and multi-line pastes can be confirmed
Also includes the zephyr command-line toolkit and the zephyr-shell interactive shell

description.p: New Qt 6 graphical terminal (zephyr-terminal) with tabs, split panes, search, profiles, SSH connections, a command palette, a settings window and session restore. Adds Nix flake, Fedora, Debian/Ubuntu, Arch Linux and AppImage packaging.
